title: The Trump Plan to Seize Voting Machines

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访几位商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无保留、未经修饰的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the Times has uncovered Donald Trump's most brazen attempt yet to overturn the results of the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 今天，《纽约时报》揭露了唐纳德·特朗普迄今为止最厚颜无耻的推翻2020年大选结果的企图。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Mike Schmidt, about exactly what
sentences.zh: 我与我的同事迈克·施密特谈到了特朗普究竟

sentences.en: Trump tried to do and whether it may tip the scales of a congressional effort to hold him legally accountable.
sentences.zh: 试图做什么，以及这是否会影响国会追究其法律责任的努力。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, February 2nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月2日，星期三。

sentences.en: So, Mike, good to be with you again.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，很高兴再次见到你。

sentences.en: It's good to be back.
sentences.zh: 很高兴回来。

sentences.en: So, just to start, what is the context in which you and our colleagues break this story?
sentences.zh: 那么，首先，你和我们的同事是在什么样的背景下挖掘出这个故事的？

sentences.en: In the year that has passed since January 6th, reporters and the specially appointed January
sentences.zh: 在1月6日事件过去的一年里，记者们和特别任命的1月

sentences.en: 6th Congressional Committee have all been trying to figure out what were the tentacles, what were
sentences.zh: 6日国会委员会一直在试图弄清楚唐纳德·特朗普及其盟友为了让他留任、保持权力并推翻选举，究竟采取了哪些手段，

sentences.en: the attempts that Donald Trump and his allies undertook to try and keep him in office, keep him in power, and overturn the election.
sentences.zh: 触角伸向了哪里。

sentences.en: A portrait of a lot of this different stuff has emerged since then.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，关于这一切的许多不同侧面已经浮出水面。

sentences.en: The Trump team brought forth dozens and dozens of lawsuits, not just in Georgia, Michigan,
sentences.zh: 特朗普团队提起了数十起诉讼，不仅仅是在佐治亚州、密歇根州、

sentences.en: Pennsylvania, and Nevada.
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州和内华达州。

sentences.en: The baseless claims made in lawsuits about voter fraud.
sentences.zh: 诉讼中关于选民欺诈的毫无根据的指控。

sentences.en: A Trump Justice Department official drafted a letter to Republican leaders in Georgia telling
sentences.zh: 特朗普司法部的一名官员起草了一封给佐治亚州共和党领导人的信，告诉

sentences.en: them to look into replacing the state's Biden electors with a new slate of Trump electors.
sentences.zh: 他们考虑用新的特朗普选举人名单取代该州的拜登选举人。

sentences.en: It's a bigger ploy to create a separate set of electors for the Electoral College.
sentences.zh: 这是一个更大的策略，旨在为选举人团创建一套独立的选举人。

sentences.en: All Vice President Pence has to do is send it back to the states to recertify, and we become president, and you are the happiest people.
sentences.zh: 彭斯副总统所要做的就是把它送回各州重新认证，我们就能成为总统，你们就是最幸福的人。

sentences.en: The pressure that Trump himself put on Vice President Mike Pence to essentially, as the person overseeing the certification of the election, pick his own president.
sentences.zh: 特朗普本人向迈克·彭斯副总统施压，要求他作为监督选举认证的人，本质上是挑选他自己的总统。

sentences.en: And Mike Pence, I hope you're going to stand up for the good of our Constitution and for the good of our country.
sentences.zh: 迈克·彭斯，我希望你能为了我们的宪法和国家的利益挺身而出。

sentences.en: And if you're not, I'm going to be very disappointed in you, I will tell you right now.
sentences.zh: 如果你不这样做，我会非常失望，我现在就告诉你。

sentences.en: But as we have learned all of these different things, one of the biggest questions has been, what was Trump's role in this stuff behind closed doors?
sentences.zh: 但当我们了解到所有这些不同的事情时，最大的问题之一就是：特朗普在幕后扮演了什么角色？

sentences.en: And how far was Trump willing to go to use the vast apparatus of the federal government and its authorities to help himself stay in power?
sentences.zh: 特朗普愿意走多远来利用庞大的联邦政府机构及其权力来帮助自己保住权力？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Not just the powers of his personal persuasion, but the actual levers of government.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是利用他个人的说服力，而是利用政府的实际杠杆。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what my colleagues and I were able to figure out over the past few days was that
sentences.zh: 我和我的同事在过去几天里能够弄清楚的是，

sentences.en: Trump was far more willing to use that apparatus than we had previously known.
sentences.zh: 特朗普比我们之前所知的更愿意动用这些机构。

sentences.en: So, Mike, at a very high level, explain what you have found.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，请从宏观层面解释一下你们发现了什么。

sentences.en: We learned that in the weeks after Joe Biden won the 2020 election, Trump considered using
sentences.zh: 我们了解到，在乔·拜登赢得2020年大选后的几周里，特朗普考虑动用

sentences.en: three of the most powerful institutions in the federal government, the Pentagon, the Justice
sentences.zh: 联邦政府中最强大的三个机构——五角大楼、司法

sentences.en: Department and the Department of Homeland Security to go out into swing states and seize boating
sentences.zh: 部和国土安全部——去摇摆州扣押投票

sentences.en: machines that Trump claimed would show there was widespread fraud in the election and that he was the true victor.
sentences.zh: 机，特朗普声称这将证明选举中存在广泛的欺诈行为，而他才是真正的获胜者。

sentences.en: So, Mike, take us inside this story that you have all now uncovered.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，带我们深入了解你们现在揭露的这个故事。

sentences.en: How did we get to a place where the president of the United States is contemplating going to these three federal agencies and having them seize voting machines?
sentences.zh: 我们是如何走到这一步的，美国总统竟然考虑去这三个联邦机构，并让他们扣押投票机？

sentences.en: After Trump lost the election, whatever the guardrails that were still there came off even more.
sentences.zh: 特朗普输掉选举后，原本存在的任何护栏都进一步消失了。

sentences.en: And this allowed a true motley crew of individuals to begin advising and surrounding the president
sentences.zh: 这使得一群真正的乌合之众开始建议并围绕在总统身边。

sentences.en: We know a lot of those figures.
sentences.zh: 我们认识其中许多人。

sentences.en: Trump's personal lawyer, Rudy Giuliani, Sidney Powell, the attorney who filed lawsuit after lawsuit in swing states on behalf of Trump, and Mike Flynn, Trump's
sentences.zh: 特朗普的私人律师鲁迪·朱利安尼、代表特朗普在摇摆州提起诉讼的律师西德尼·鲍威尔，以及特朗普的

sentences.en: former national security advisor.
sentences.zh: 前国家安全顾问迈克·弗林。

sentences.en: But there was another figure, someone far less known, and his name is Phil Waldron.
sentences.zh: 但还有另一个人，一个鲜为人知的人，他的名字叫菲尔·沃尔德伦。

sentences.en: And who is Phil Waldron?
sentences.zh: 菲尔·沃尔德伦是谁？

sentences.en: Phil Waldron is a retired Army colonel who had a background in psychological operations.
sentences.zh: 菲尔·沃尔德伦是一位退役陆军上校，有心理战背景。

sentences.en: And in that chaotic post-election period, found his way to Sidney Powell, who was filing these conspiracy-laden lawsuits that were challenging the election.
sentences.zh: 在选举后那段混乱时期，他找到了西德尼·鲍威尔，后者当时正在提起那些挑战选举结果、充满阴谋论的诉讼。

sentences.en: And Waldron claimed that he had identified irregularities in public data that showed that the voting results were fraudulent.
sentences.zh: 沃尔德伦声称他已经在公开数据中发现了异常，表明投票结果是欺诈性的。

sentences.en: Waldron thought that he had evidence that China or Chinese-controlled software companies had hacked into voting machines.
sentences.zh: 沃尔德伦认为他有证据表明中国或中国控制的软件公司黑进了投票机。

sentences.en: And the only way to truly prove his claims was to get his hands on the machines themselves.
sentences.zh: 而真正证明他主张的唯一方法就是拿到机器本身。

sentences.en: He circulated a lengthy PowerPoint presentation laying this out.
sentences.zh: 他散发了一份详尽的 PowerPoint 演示文稿来阐述这一点。

sentences.en: That presentation makes it to
sentences.zh: 那份演示文稿传到了

sentences.en: Trump's legal team.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的法律团队手中。

sentences.en: And somehow, in the mess and swirl of all of this, is communicated to Trump.
sentences.zh: 不知何故，在这一切的混乱和漩涡中，它被传达给了特朗普。

sentences.en: And we begin to see examples of Trump raising the idea directly with the people running those powerful national institutions.
sentences.zh: 我们开始看到特朗普直接向管理这些强大国家机构的人提出这个想法的例子。

sentences.en: And in mid to late November, we see one of the first examples of Trump weighing the idea.
sentences.zh: 在11月中下旬，我们看到了特朗普权衡这个想法的最初例子之一。

sentences.en: In an Oval Office meeting with Attorney General Bill Barr, Trump says, my lawyers say that the Justice Department could go out and seize these machines.
sentences.zh: 在与司法部长比尔·巴尔的椭圆形办公室会议上，特朗普说，我的律师说司法部可以去扣押这些机器。

sentences.en: Could the Justice Department do that?
sentences.zh: 司法部能那样做吗？

sentences.en: And Barr, who had become an increasingly strong force against the president, pushing back on the president's false claims of election fraud, says, absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 巴尔，他已成为反对总统的越来越强大的力量，反驳总统关于选举欺诈的虚假主张，他说，绝对不行。

sentences.en: There's no evidence of criminality.
sentences.zh: 没有任何犯罪证据。

sentences.en: There's no probable cause.
sentences.zh: 没有任何合理怀疑。

sentences.en: There's no way the Justice Department, which should have no role in elections, could do something extraordinary like this.
sentences.zh: 本应在选举中毫无角色的司法部，绝不可能做出这种非同寻常的事情。

sentences.en: So Barr says no.
sentences.zh: 所以巴尔拒绝了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But at the same time, Waldron is continuing his efforts.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，沃尔德伦仍在继续他的努力。

sentences.en: He knows Mike Flynn because both of them worked at the Defense Intelligence Agency during the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 他认识迈克·弗林，因为他们两人在奥巴马政府期间都在国防情报局工作。

sentences.en: And Waldron goes to Flynn.
sentences.zh: 沃尔德伦去找了弗林。

sentences.en: And what he pitches Flynn on is a pretty big escalation of the boating machine idea.
sentences.zh: 他向弗林推销的是对投票机想法的相当大的升级。

sentences.en: And what is his pitch?
sentences.zh: 他的推销是什么？

sentences.en: He suggests using the Pentagon, the Department of Defense, to seize the machines.
sentences.zh: 他建议利用五角大楼，即国防部，来扣押这些机器。

sentences.en: And on December 17th, and the president does have some options, at least on paper.
sentences.zh: 在12月17日，总统确实有一些选择，至少在纸面上是这样。

sentences.en: Can you tell us what those options are and your opinion, if he might take any of them?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们这些选择是什么，以及你认为他是否会采取其中任何一个吗？

sentences.en: Well, you know, I don't know if he's going to.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我不知道他是否会这样做。

sentences.en: Flynn goes on Newsmax, the far right media channel.
sentences.zh: 弗林上了极右翼媒体频道 Newsmax。

sentences.en: One of the options.
sentences.zh: 其中一个选择。

sentences.en: I mean, he could immediately, on his order, seize every single one of these machines around the country on his order.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他可以立即下令，扣押全国每一台这样的机器。

sentences.en: He could also order, he could order the, within the swimming states, if he wanted to, he could take military capabilities and he could place them
sentences.zh: 他还可以下令，如果他愿意，他可以在摇摆州内采取军事能力，并可以将它们

sentences.en: in those states and basically rerun an election in each of those states.
sentences.zh: 部署在这些州，基本上在每个州重新进行选举。

sentences.en: I mean, it's not unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这并非没有先例。

sentences.en: I mean, these people.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些人。

sentences.en: To say that the military has the authority to take such an action.
sentences.zh: 声称军队有权采取这种行动。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So presumably, Flynn thinks Trump will either watch his appearance on Newsmax or that what he says will somehow reach inside the White House.
sentences.zh: 所以大概弗林认为特朗普要么会看他在 Newsmax 上的露面，要么他所说的话会以某种方式传进白宫。

sentences.en: That is a very common way people reach Trump throughout his presidency.
sentences.zh: 这是人们在整个总统任期内接触特朗普的一种非常常见的方式。

sentences.en: And what we know is that the very next day, December 18th, Flynn shows up to the White House with Sidney Powell.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，就在第二天，12月18日，弗林带着西德尼·鲍威尔出现在白宫。

sentences.en: They're escorted into the Oval Office where they meet with Trump and his advisors and lawyers.
sentences.zh: 他们被护送到椭圆形办公室，在那里他们会见了特朗普及其顾问和律师。

sentences.en: And it's here that they pitch Trump directly on the idea of deploying the U.S.
sentences.zh: 正是在这里，他们直接向特朗普推销部署美国

sentences.en: military to seize the voting machines.
sentences.zh: 军队扣押投票机的想法。

sentences.en: And to be clear, there's still no evidence of any fraud related to any of these voting machines.
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，仍然没有任何与这些投票机相关的欺诈证据。

sentences.en: So this is all seemingly based on a PowerPoint presentation from this former colonel connected to Mike Flynn.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切似乎都是基于这位与迈克·弗林有关的前上校的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。

sentences.en: And this idea that the Pentagon should seize voting machines based on that PowerPoint presentation.
sentences.zh: 以及五角大楼应该基于该演示文稿扣押投票机的想法。

sentences.en: That has reached the Oval Office and the ear of the president.
sentences.zh: 这已经传到了椭圆形办公室和总统的耳中。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app unlocked.
sentences.zh: 解锁《纽约时报》应用程序。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month for free without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 一个月的时间让你越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So Mike, finish the story of what happens during this Oval Office meeting.
sentences.zh: 那么迈克，讲完这次椭圆形办公室会议期间发生的事情。

sentences.en: So Flynn and Powell have essentially gotten this idea of deploying the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以弗林和鲍威尔基本上已经把部署美国

sentences.en: military to seize voting machines on the desk of the president.
sentences.zh: 军队扣押投票机的想法放到了总统的桌面上。

sentences.en: Flynn and Powell present the idea to Trump and have a draft executive order for him to sign to put all of this into motion.
sentences.zh: 弗林和鲍威尔向特朗普提出了这个想法，并有一份行政命令草案供他签署，以启动这一切。

sentences.en: White House staffers are deeply unnerved by this because they know that this is way outside the bounds of what a president should be doing in the midst of an election.
sentences.zh: 白宫工作人员对此感到非常不安，因为他们知道这完全超出了总统在选举期间应该做的范围。

sentences.en: Rudy Giuliani, who's in Washington, is summoned to the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 身在华盛顿的鲁迪·朱利安尼被传唤到椭圆形办公室。

sentences.en: And Giuliani, who throughout the Trump presidency was usually the first person in the door with the idea
sentences.zh: 朱利安尼在整个特朗普总统任期内通常是第一个带着别人认为糟糕的想法进门的人，

sentences.en: that everyone else thought was a bad one, says he vehemently opposes this idea.
sentences.zh: 他说他强烈反对这个想法。

sentences.en: Giuliani tells Trump that legally, the military should not get involved in the electoral process.
sentences.zh: 朱利安尼告诉特朗普，从法律上讲，军队不应该参与选举过程。

sentences.en: The only possible exception for that would be if there was foreign interference.
sentences.zh: 唯一的例外可能是如果有外国干预。

sentences.en: But Powell says she does have evidence of foreign influence, something we should say has never been proven or corroborated.
sentences.zh: 但鲍威尔说她确实有外国影响的证据，我们应该说这从未被证明或证实过。

sentences.en: In the end, Giuliani prevails and he persuades Trump against the idea of using the military and Trump decides not to do it.
sentences.zh: 最终，朱利安尼占了上风，他说服特朗普放弃了动用军队的想法，特朗普决定不这样做。

sentences.en: So at this point, President Trump has very seriously entertained the possibility of asking two federal agencies to intervene in the election by seizing
sentences.zh: 所以此时，特朗普总统已经非常认真地考虑过要求两个联邦机构通过扣押

sentences.en: voting machines, which leaves a third and final agency, the Department of Homeland Security.
sentences.zh: 投票机来干预选举的可能性，这留下了第三个也是最后一个机构，即国土安全部。

sentences.en: So what happens with that agency?
sentences.zh: 那么那个机构发生了什么？

sentences.en: So Waldron, that former army colonel who originally came up with this idea, alters the draft executive order and replaces the Pentagon with the Department of Homeland Security.
sentences.zh: 所以沃尔德伦，那位最初提出这个想法的前陆军上校，修改了行政命令草案，用国土安全部取代了五角大楼。

sentences.en: Mm hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So the idea being that DHS would go out and seize the machines.
sentences.zh: 所以想法是国土安全部会去扣押这些机器。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Giuliani, apparently swayed by the fact that it's just a different department, pitches Trump on that idea.
sentences.zh: 朱利安尼显然被这只是一个不同部门的事实所动摇，向特朗普推销了这个想法。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: Trump, still searching for something, asked Giuliani to vet the legality of it by reaching out to the number
sentences.zh: 特朗普仍在寻找某种东西，要求朱利安尼通过联系国土安全部的二号人物，

sentences.en: two guy at the Department of Homeland Security, a longtime conservative firebrand named Ken Cuccinelli.
sentences.zh: 一位名叫肯·库奇内利的长期保守派煽动者，来审查其合法性。

sentences.en: Cuccinelli tells Giuliani, we're not doing that.
sentences.zh: 库奇内利告诉朱利安尼，我们不会那样做。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Cuccinelli says that DHS lacks the power and authority to impound machines and audit them.
sentences.zh: 库奇内利说，国土安全部缺乏扣押机器并对其进行审计的权力和权限。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And with that, this plan that Waldron started working on in the middle of the 2020 election that made its way all the way to the president of the United States dies.
sentences.zh: 至此，沃尔德伦在2020年大选期间开始着手、一直传到美国总统那里的这个计划破灭了。

sentences.en: And just to be clear, Mike, at each turn, key leaders of these agencies, Cuccinelli, Barr, basically say, no, we refuse to be drawn into this plot to seize the voting machines
sentences.zh: 迈克，明确一点，在每一个转折点，这些机构的关键领导人，库奇内利、巴尔，基本上都说，不，我们拒绝被卷入这个扣押投票机的阴谋中，

sentences.en: because there's no evidence or we're not sure it's legal.
sentences.zh: 因为没有证据，或者我们不确定它是否合法。

sentences.en: And in that sense, they did their jobs, right?
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，他们尽职尽责了，对吧？

sentences.en: Which feels very reminiscent of the local officials like the Secretary of State in Georgia who turned down Trump's request to play a role in overturning the election.
sentences.zh: 这让人想起佐治亚州州务卿等地方官员，他们拒绝了特朗普要求在推翻选举中发挥作用的请求。

sentences.en: But in this case, the willingness of these people to say no stands out a bit more because they answer to the president.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，这些人说不的意愿更突出一些，因为他们对总统负责。

sentences.en: At any moment, Donald Trump could have fired them.
sentences.zh: 在任何时刻，唐纳德·特朗普都可能解雇他们。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they might have said yes.
sentences.zh: 而他们本可以说是的。

sentences.en: These political appointees who could have been fired at any point by Trump
sentences.zh: 这些随时可能被特朗普解雇的政治任命人员

sentences.en: could have said yes and done what he wanted and sent the country into uncharted waters where the federal government was going into states to seize voting machines.
sentences.zh: 本可以说是的，并按照他的意愿行事，将国家带入未知的领域，联邦政府进入各州扣押投票机。

sentences.en: Mike, stepping back for just a moment, everything you're describing here is very startling.
sentences.zh: 迈克，退后一步，你在这里描述的一切都非常令人震惊。

sentences.en: And it's very much outside the norms of what we would ever expect from a president.
sentences.zh: 这非常超出了我们对总统所期望的规范。

sentences.en: But it fits a pattern that we have observed for a long time with this president.
sentences.zh: 但这符合我们长期以来观察到的这位总统的一贯行事模式。

sentences.en: And so far, Trump has not been held legally accountable for any of it.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，特朗普尚未就此承担任何法律责任。

sentences.en: When it comes to January 6th and everything he did around the 2020 election, he was impeached, but that's a political process, not a legal one.
sentences.zh: 谈到1月6日事件以及他在2020年大选前后的所作所为，他虽然遭到弹劾，但那是一个政治程序，而非法律程序。

sentences.en: So how might this particularly startling new set of events that you have just described, how might that change the prospect of holding Trump legally accountable
sentences.zh: 那么，你刚刚描述的这组特别令人震惊的新事件，可能会如何改变让特朗普承担法律责任的前景呢？

sentences.en: for his efforts to overturn the results of the 2020 election?
sentences.zh: 即针对他试图推翻2020年大选结果的行为？

sentences.en: Does it change those prospects?
sentences.zh: 这会改变那些前景吗？

sentences.en: So this special committee on Capitol Hill, the January 6th committee, is looking at everything that happened around the election and attack on the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 国会山的一个特别委员会，即1月6日调查委员会，正在审视大选前后发生的一切以及对国会大厦的袭击。

sentences.en: But it's not just a fact-finding mission.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅仅是一项事实调查任务。

sentences.en: At the end of this investigation, the committee will make a decision about whether to ask the Justice Department
sentences.zh: 在调查结束时，委员会将决定是否要求司法部

sentences.en: to open a criminal investigation and prosecute those who the committee believes committed crimes.
sentences.zh: 展开刑事调查，并起诉那些委员会认为犯下罪行的人。

sentences.en: And the committee sees that as its best attempt to try and contain Trump.
sentences.zh: 委员会将其视为遏制特朗普的最佳尝试。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: To hold Trump accountable and potentially stop him from becoming president in 2024.
sentences.zh: 追究特朗普的责任，并可能阻止他在2024年再次当选总统。

sentences.en: So they may ask for a criminal investigation into Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以他们可能会要求对特朗普进行刑事调查。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: At the end of the investigation, they will look at the evidence and say,
sentences.zh: 在调查结束时，他们会审视证据并判断：

sentences.en: is there enough here to say to the Justice Department that it should investigate and prosecute the president?
sentences.zh: 现有的证据是否足以要求司法部对总统进行调查和起诉？

sentences.en: And what this revelation about voting machines does is draw Trump directly into the attempts to overturn the election in a much bigger way than we knew before.
sentences.zh: 而关于投票机的这一披露，将特朗普直接卷入了试图推翻大选的行动中，其程度远超我们之前的认知。

sentences.en: So when the committee sits down, when it's done, it will be able to make an argument, perhaps now a stronger argument, about Trump's direct involvement in all of this activity.
sentences.zh: 因此，当委员会坐下来总结时，它将能够提出一个论点，或许现在是一个更有力的论点，关于特朗普直接参与了所有这些活动。

sentences.en: And for the committee, the more damning evidence that it has about Trump,
sentences.zh: 对于委员会来说，它掌握的关于特朗普的证据越确凿，

sentences.en: the more pressure it thinks it can put on Attorney General Merrick Garland to do something and to not look the other way.
sentences.zh: 它认为自己就能给司法部长梅里克·加兰施加越大的压力，促使他采取行动，而不是视而不见。

sentences.en: So in theory, Mike, these new revelations that you all have uncovered might strengthen the January 6th committee's argument for asking the Department of Justice
sentences.zh: 所以迈克，理论上讲，你们揭露的这些新发现可能会加强1月6日委员会要求司法部

sentences.en: to prosecute Donald Trump over his behavior after the election.
sentences.zh: 就唐纳德·特朗普在大选后的行为对他进行起诉的论据。

sentences.en: But is anything Trump did here actually illegal?
sentences.zh: 但特朗普在这里所做的任何事情真的违法吗？

sentences.en: It's not against the law for the president to explore a bad idea and not do it.
sentences.zh: 总统去探讨一个糟糕的想法却最终没有实施，这并不违法。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And here, he didn't do it.
sentences.zh: 而在这里，他并没有付诸行动。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But if the committee is trying to make a larger argument about a wide-ranging conspiracy that Trump undertook or participated in to overthrow the election,
sentences.zh: 但如果委员会试图就特朗普为推翻大选而策划或参与的广泛阴谋提出一个更大的论点，

sentences.en: bringing him directly into it is a powerful piece of evidence and is a powerful fact.
sentences.zh: 将他直接牵涉其中是一个强有力的证据，也是一个强有力的事实。

sentences.en: The Democrats on the committee and the top Republican, Liz Cheney, they know that Trump is out there.
sentences.zh: 委员会里的民主党人以及共和党高层利兹·切尼，他们知道特朗普就在那里。

sentences.en: They know that Trump thinks that January 6th was a good thing.
sentences.zh: 他们知道特朗普认为1月6日事件是一件好事。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And that Trump recently said that he would pardon the rioters if he's re-elected president in 2024.
sentences.zh: 而且特朗普最近表示，如果他在2024年再次当选总统，他会赦免那些骚乱者。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And what the committee is trying to do is come up with the most compelling, damning narrative about Trump that leaves the attorney general with no choice but to investigate him.
sentences.zh: 委员会试图做的是，提出关于特朗普最令人信服、最确凿的叙述，让司法部长别无选择，只能对他进行调查。

sentences.en: Understood.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: But ultimately, Mike, the committee may not make a successful legal argument for prosecuting President Trump.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，迈克，委员会可能无法提出一个成功的法律论据来起诉特朗普总统。

sentences.en: In fact, the bar seems pretty high for that and the chances of a successful prosecution relatively low, right?
sentences.zh: 事实上，这方面的门槛似乎很高，成功起诉的可能性相对较低，对吧？

sentences.en: And if that's the case, what becomes of a revelation like the one that you've laid out here?
sentences.zh: 如果真是这样，像你在这里披露的这类事实又有什么意义呢？

sentences.en: And ultimately, what's the value of having uncovered it?
sentences.zh: 归根结底，揭露这些事实的价值何在？

sentences.en: We talk these days a lot about threats to democracy.
sentences.zh: 如今我们经常谈论对民主的威胁。

sentences.en: How real are they?
sentences.zh: 它们有多真实？

sentences.en: Are they overstated?
sentences.zh: 是否被夸大了？

sentences.en: In this case, we can see that the threat to democracy was quite real.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，我们可以看到对民主的威胁是相当真实的。

sentences.en: It was inside the Oval Office in front of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 它就发生在椭圆形办公室里，就在唐纳德·特朗普面前。

sentences.en: The threat to the democracy was the president being just a few yeses away from underlings getting American soldiers or DHS agents to seize boating machines from key swing states.
sentences.zh: 对民主的威胁在于，总统距离下令下属动用美国士兵或国土安全部特工从关键摇摆州扣押投票机，只差几个“同意”的决定。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: That would have created a national uproar.
sentences.zh: 那会引发全国性的骚乱。

sentences.en: It would have brought people into the streets, brought the outcome of the election into question.
sentences.zh: 那会让人群走上街头，让大选结果受到质疑。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And then where would we have been?
sentences.zh: 那我们当时会处于什么样的境地？

sentences.en: And so no matter what criminal referral is or isn't made at the end of this congressional investigation, you want to know these details.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论这次国会调查最终是否提出刑事移交，你都想了解这些细节。

sentences.en: You need to know these details so that we can understand just how vulnerable the democracy really was and still is.
sentences.zh: 你需要了解这些细节，这样我们才能理解民主曾经是多么脆弱，而且现在依然如此。

sentences.en: Mike, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 迈克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: During an appearance on Tuesday, Russian President Vladimir Putin accused the US of trying to pull it into an armed conflict over Ukraine that Russia does not want.
sentences.zh: 周二在一次露面中，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京指责美国试图将俄罗斯卷入一场它并不想要的乌克兰武装冲突。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that Putin has amassed 100,000 Russian troops on Ukraine's borders, Putin claimed that it was the Biden administration that wanted a war.
sentences.zh: 尽管普京已在乌克兰边境集结了10万俄军，但他声称是拜登政府想要战争。

sentences.en: So it would have an excuse to impose tough sanctions against Russia.
sentences.zh: 这样它就有借口对俄罗斯实施严厉制裁。

sentences.en: When the fox is screaming from the top of the hen house that he's scared of the chickens, which is essentially what they're doing, that fear isn't reported as a statement of fact.
sentences.zh: 当狐狸在鸡舍顶上尖叫说它害怕鸡时——这本质上就是他们正在做的事情——这种恐惧并不会被当作事实陈述来报道。

sentences.en: At the White House, Press Secretary Jen Psaki reacted to Putin's claims with derision.
sentences.zh: 在白宫，新闻秘书珍·普萨基嘲讽地回应了普京的说法。

sentences.en: We know who the fox is in this case.
sentences.zh: 我们知道谁才是这起事件中的狐狸。

sentences.en: We have seen the buildup of troops at the border.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到了边境上的军队集结。

sentences.en: And Pfizer has asked the Food and Drug Administration to authorize its COVID vaccine for children younger than five, the only Americans not yet eligible for vaccination.
sentences.zh: 辉瑞公司已要求食品药品监督管理局批准其新冠疫苗用于五岁以下儿童，这是美国唯一尚未获得疫苗接种资格的群体。

sentences.en: Pfizer is asking the FDA to approve a two-dose vaccination,
sentences.zh: 辉瑞正在要求FDA批准两剂疫苗接种方案，

sentences.en: even though a clinical trial of two doses conducted by the company failed to produce the immune response Pfizer had hoped for in many young children.
sentences.zh: 尽管该公司进行的两剂临床试验在许多幼儿身上未能产生辉瑞所期望的免疫反应。

sentences.en: Pfizer has said it believes that three doses of its vaccine will ultimately be required to fully vaccinate most children under five.
sentences.zh: 辉瑞表示，它认为最终需要三剂疫苗才能使大多数五岁以下儿童获得完全免疫。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Mooj Zaidi, Rochelle Banja, and Austin Mitchell.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由Mooj Zaidi、Rochelle Banja和Austin Mitchell制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Mark George and Paige Cowett and contains original music from Marion Lozano and Dan Powell and engineered by Dan Powell.
sentences.zh: 由Mark George和Paige Cowett编辑，包含Marion Lozano和Dan Powell的原创音乐，并由Dan Powell进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的Jim Brunberg和Ben Lansford创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正准备迎接节假日的客人。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全遮光才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
